name: Event Tick
description: Fires every frame while the actor is active. Use for per-frame logic like movement, timers, and animations. Keep it lightweight.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Execution pin. Runs once per frame. Connect to any node that should update every frame (e.g. Move Actor, Update Timer).

outputs.name: Delta Seconds
outputs.description: Time in seconds since the last tick. Connect to math or movement nodes to make behavior framerate-independent.
